summary.en-US: YouTube videos pick up where you left off, even when you click a thumbnail after its preview.

description.en-US:
- **After a hover preview:** on Firefox, YouTube restarts a video at 0:00 when you click it after watching its preview (Chrome keeps playing from the preview). With this add-on, it keeps playing from the preview.
- **Videos you left halfway:** next time you open them, they continue where you stopped, even if you're not signed in.

Timestamp links, ads, live streams and Shorts are left alone. One setting, in the toolbar button: how long positions are remembered (15 days by default).

**Private:** positions are stored in your browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
